6. Her supplication at the time of her death seeking divine pleasure
introduction:
Her supplication at the time of her death seeking divine pleasure

It is narrated from Abdullah bin Hasan from his father, from his grandfather that when Fatima, daughter of the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.a.) was in her last moments, she cast a prolonged glance then she said:

Then she said: Can you all see what I see? She was asked: What can you see? She replied: These are the groups of the folks of heavens, and this is Jibraeel, and this is the Messenger of Allah, who is saying: Come, my child, whatever is before you is much better for you.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰي جَبْرَئِیْلَ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰي رَسُوْلِ اللهِ۔
اَللّٰهُمَّ مَعَ رَسُوْلِكَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ فِیْ رِضْوَانِكَ وَ جِوَارِكَ وَ دَارِكَ دَارِ السَّلَامِ۔
